provenance.note: The twenty label placements were extracted from the Series 1 sheet's explicit transformation matrices, not from a product datasheet. That sheet was physically printed on real Avery 94106 stock and confirmed clean by the operator on 2026-08-11, so this grid is known to register on the operator's printer rather than inferred from a specification.
provenance.drift_note: The extracted values carried at most 0.1 pt of rounding drift from Avery's exporter (0.0014 in, invisible). The values here are the normalized figures with that drift removed.
provenance.unresolved: The extraction cannot settle which part of the 117 pt cell is bleed and which is die-cut. All content is therefore confined to the conservative centred safe area below, and a physical overlay proof on plain paper is required before label stock is loaded (KDR-21).

grid.numbering: row-major from the top-left: cell 1 is the first column origin paired with the first row origin, cell 20 the last of each

safe_area.note: KDR-13: all content lives inside this centred 100 x 100 pt box within the 117 pt cell.
